course.title: TV Engineering
course.department: Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering

content.value: A four-port multimode fiber FBT coupler has 60 μW optical power launched into port 1. The measured output powers at port 2, 3, and 4 are 0.004, 26.0, and 27.50 uW, respectively. Détermine the excess loss, the insertion losses between the input and output ports, the crosstalk and the split ratio for the device.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2017
